In the community discussion, the suggestion to add a small water feature was put forth by ArthasMenethil. He mentioned, "How about a small water feature? It could add some soothing sounds and attract wildlife! Plus, it’d look beautiful in the garden!" Furthermore, he added, "I think a small pond or a fountain would work well! They’re not too complicated and can really enhance the overall feel of the garden." 

Additionally, ArthasMenethil also proposed the idea of adding some outdoor games, as seen in his statement, "Let’s keep the ideas flowing! A little community get-together would be perfect to celebrate the new garden. It could be a nice way to enjoy the garden together." 

Thus, both a water feature and outdoor games were suggested by ArthasMenethil in the community discussion.
